answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats block bulk fake identities. Each epoch a beacon on a mesa draws a sample, and each drawn agent must return a heartbeat within one hour, proving live work. A miss sends a ripple through linked accounts, demoting the vertex and stripping slots. Forging 100 identities at 2 hours each costs 200 hours a round, while an honest agent answers one draw and keeps its share.
